tools.name: discover_paid_api
tools.description:
Discover pay-per-request API endpoints for a given capability.

Returns ranked, verified endpoints with pricing and reliability metrics.
Use this to find APIs before calling them. The results include:
- Endpoint URL and method
- Price per call and payment network
- Success rate and latency metrics

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description:
List available API capability types.

Use this to explore what kinds of APIs are available in the registry.
You can filter by tag (e.g., "weather", "translation") or search by keyword.

Note: A capability existing does not mean verified endpoints are available for it. Use discover_paid_api to check

tools.name: call_paid_api
tools.description:
Call a previously discovered API endpoint.

Use this after discover_paid_api to execute the request.

IMPORTANT: You must first use discover_paid_api to find an endpoint.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "discover_paid_api" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
